<a id="when_to_hold_em"></a>
## Country Story Song: `when_to_hold_em.yml`

A country story song of the late seventies in the manner of The Gambler (Don Schlitz, as Kenny
Rogers recorded it), with a tune of its own. A Guitarify picks a bass note and strums each chord of
I, IV and V; the fiddle opens with the chorus phrase; a quick verse and a chorus of one phrase
climbing step by step; the third verse and all after a half step up; one chorus over hand claps and
a kick alone.
